Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Baytown for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, at least 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (Baytown Christmas Parade and Holiday Hangout at Town Square) through January 5, 2027 (Holiday Hangout), with December 5 (Christmas on Texas Avenue Festival at Baytown Town Square), December 10 (Santa Photos and Storytime) and December 17 (The Muppet Christmas Carol at Lee College Performing Arts Center) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Baytown

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Baytown
  • At least 2 free events, including the Baytown Christmas Parade and Christmas on Texas Avenue Festival
  • Meet Santa: Santa Photos and Storytime on December 10 and 17
  • Parades: Baytown Christmas Parade on December 3
  • Skating and hay maze: Holiday Hangout at Town Square
  • Season: December 3 to January 5, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Baytown families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Houston, which covers Zoo Lights at the Houston Zoo, The Nutcracker with Houston Ballet, skating with Santa at Discovery Green and the Polar Express train ride.
